connector.name: DanBooks - AI Bookkeeping
connector.registryDescription: AI bookkeeping for small business. Create invoices, log expenses, and check P&L by voice or text.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package danbooks-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the jeremiahclark79-ai account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.
